notes.title: Update Notes v1.0.18
notes.notes:
Now we have included Japanese Language!
It's the hardest language to implement by far, because there's multiple way to write a word.
For example:

出張 means business trip

In hiragana it could be written
しゅっちょう

To write that in Hiragana, you could write it one by one per character, like this
si lyu ltu ti lyo u

(where the small hiragana character need to be written with prefix l or x)

In this case, there's multiple way to write し, which is si, shi, or ci.
To write ゅ, you could type lyu, or xyu
To write っ, you could type ltu, ltsu, xtu, xtsu
To write ち, you could type ti, or chi
To write ょ, you could type lyo, or xyo
To write う, you could type u, wu, whu

To make matter worse, there's a shortcut to write しゅ, together it could be typed as syu, or shu.

And the hardest part is this っちょ. You could write it together as ttyo (with double t).
Or it could be ccyo, or ccho.
Or you could write it a little bit separately, like ttilyo, ttixyo, cchilyo, cchixyo.
Or you could write this っ first as ltu, ltsu, xtu, xtsu, and write this ちょ as tyo, cyo, cho, or even separately tilyo, tixyo, chilyo, chixyo.

I hope with this update, it's already covered all this stuff.
If you are fluent in Japanese Typing, please do try it!

notes.title: Update Notes v1.0.17
notes.notes:
Hey we have added support for Russian language!
So you could type with Cyrillic alphabet now.

And we fix several bug:
- the difficulty is not saved when quiting
- character name has not been localized
- when you finished a restaurant, when you replay and finish a level, it will go to wishlist page instead of continue

And we add some rebalance and QoL:
- the rat spawn less in Italian Restaurant
- the customer will dim if it's not interactable
- the customer will have angry emoticon when their patience is empty.
